newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two car bombs kill three in Algeria - residents.
newsitem.headline: Two car bombs kill three in Algeria - residents.

text.p: Two car bombs on Wednesday killed at least three people and wounded scores in the centre of Blida, 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, said residents speaking by telephone from the garrison city.
The first car bomb exploded at about 10.a.m (0900 GMT) in a market in central Blida killing at least two and wounding many more, residents said.
"It was in Souk al Ahad market," said one resident.
The second bomb went off later in the main street in central Blida, killing one and wounding several others, said another resident.
